name: CHIP auto-suggestion boundary test
notes: REGRESSION TEST for bug 2. After a tee shot, club selection moves the flag target to ~270y (stock distance). Player walks to ball. App must use the GREEN ANCHOR (far end of hole) for CHIP detection, not the moved flag. So at the ball position ~230y from green, CHIP must NOT trigger. Then at 35y from green it should. Pause at 50y to verify APPROACH is still selected before continuing.
